achieved.claim: Consolidated total revenue stood at INR 1,983 crore, registering a growth of 3% YoY and QoQ.
EBITDA for the quarter increased by 16% year-on-year to INR 219 crore.
Phenolics segment revenues stood at INR 1,334 crore and EBIT reached INR 145 crore, a 20% YoY increase.
Advanced Intermediates Q3 FY26 revenue reached INR 652 crore, reflecting a growth of 18% YoY.

pushback.concern: Is destocking really the reason for margin compression, or were additional volumes placed at lower margins?
What is the volume and pricing breakup of the decline in Advanced Intermediates revenue over the last three years?
What led to the delay of close to 2 years in the commercialization of our MIBK and MIBC project?
Why is there a disconnect between international phenol spreads and the improved gross margins in Phenolics?

output.tone_why: Management highlighted complex operating environments, pricing pressures, and project delays while remaining cautiously optimistic.
